The '''T-21 hyper particle exchange chamber''' was an imagined [[Starship/Legends|starship]] part made up by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] while on her mission to [[Yitheeth]] to try to pass themselves off as traders, and not reveal themselves to the [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]].
